setup.command: command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 || { uv tool install 'ruff==0.8.6' >/dev/null 2>&1; ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/ruff" /usr/local/bin/ruff 2>/dev/null || true; }; command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 || { apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1; apt-get install -y git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
